name: Plants
description: Plant parts. Stalks, flower centres and leaves grow into air (air.glslinc), roots grow into soil (soil.glslinc). One species is a set of plant voxels that point at each other through their index fields. The .g channel holds the plant id (given to the seed, copied to every part that grows from it; 0 and 1 mean none yet), the .b channel height (low byte) and spread (high byte). Analysis.glsl counts the voxels of each plant id and records its species (s1).

s0.label: Plant part
s0.description: Which part of a plant this voxel is. Decides what s2..s7 mean.

s1.label: Species id
s1.description: Read by Analysis.glsl, which counts the voxels of each plant and records the species of the first voxel it counts. Give all parts of one species the same id and every species its own id. 0 = the species isn't recorded. At most 2047 (stored in the top 11 bits of the count).

0.name: Seed
0.description: Placed on soil. On its first step it takes a new plant id (.g). After that it spawns growable roots below and, with the germination chance, a growable stalk above, both carrying that id. Turns into a stalk once a stalk is above it.

s2.label: Growable stalk
s2.description: Spawned in the air cell directly above the seed when it germinates (height 2).

s3.label: Stalk
s3.description: The seed turns into this once a growable stalk or stalk is directly above it.

s4.label: Growable roots
s4.description: Spawned straight away (no chance roll) in the soil cell directly below the seed, at depth 1, once the seed has its plant id.

s5.label: Germination speed
s5.description: Chance per step that the air above the seed becomes the growable stalk (s2). Starts once the seed has its plant id.

1.name: Growable stalk
1.description: The growing tip of a stalk or of a side branch. The air above it copies it with height+1 until max height, then gets a flower centre. Branch tips (spread > 0) extend sideways instead.

s2.label: Stalk
s2.description: Turns into this once a growable stalk, stalk or flower centre is directly above it, or once its side branch has grown one cell further.

s3.label: Flower centre
s3.description: Placed on top when the main stalk reaches max height (only if no other centre is in the 3x3x3 box), or at the end of a side branch.

s4.label: Growth speed
s4.description: Chance per step to grow up one cell or to place the flower centre. When this cell is the trunk next to empty air, also the side-branch chance (scaled by 0.00008 instead).

s5.label: Max height
s5.description: Height (counted from the seed, the first stalk cell is 2) at which the main stalk stops and places its flower centre. Side branches only start below it.

s6.label: Max side spread
s6.description: Length of the lowest side branches in cells. Higher branches get shorter: s6 - (height - 2) / 2, at least 1.

s7.label: Max buds
s7.description: Number of branch tiers is s7 / 2 (so 1 means no branches). Tiers start at heights 2, 4, 6... and alternate between the X and Z axis.

2.name: Stalk
2.description: A finished piece of stalk. Air cells beside it can start a side branch using its s2.

s2.label: Side stalk
s2.description: Growable stalk spawned beside this stalk to start a side branch (spread 1).

s3.label: Flower centre
s3.description: Not read by the shader at the moment (only the growable stalk's s3 is). Keep it equal to the growable stalk's s3.

s4.label: Side growth speed
s4.description: Chance per step that an empty cell beside this stalk starts a side branch.

s5.label: Max height
s5.description: Side branches only start below this height.

s6.label: Max side spread
s6.description: Length of the lowest side branches in cells. Higher branches get shorter: s6 - (height - 2) / 2, at least 1.

s7.label: Max buds
s7.description: Number of branch tiers is s7 / 2 (so 1 means no branches). Tiers start at heights 2, 4, 6... and alternate between the X and Z axis.

3.name: Flower centre
3.description: Top of a stalk or branch. Air around it becomes leaves/petals (s2).

s2.label: Leaf
s2.description: Spawned in air cells next to the centre, at distance 1 from it.

s4.label: Bloom speed
s4.description: Chance per step that an air cell next to the centre becomes a leaf. The default 10000 means every step.

s5.label: Crown height
s5.description: 2 or more also places leaves in the cells diagonally below the centre (one level down, cardinal directions).

s6.label: Max petal radius
s6.description: 1 = leaves only in the 4 cardinal neighbours of the centre. More than 1 = in any of the 8 neighbours on the centre's level. Further spread is controlled by the leaf's own s6.

4.name: Leaf
4.description: Leaf or petal around a flower centre. Spreads to neighbours until its max radius.

s2.label: Next leaf
s2.description: Spawned beside this leaf (same level) with distance + 1. Usually the leaf itself; point it at another leaf to get colour rings.

s4.label: Spread speed
s4.description: Chance per step that an air cell beside this leaf becomes the next leaf. Only happens while at most 2 leaves are around that cell.

s6.label: Max radius
s6.description: Maximum distance from the flower centre.

5.name: Growable roots
5.description: Growing tip of the roots. Soil below copies it with depth + 1, soil beside it with spread + 1. Turns into roots (s2) when it can't grow further.

s2.label: Roots
s2.description: The tip turns into this when roots are below it or it reached max depth, with chance s4 x 0.0001 per step (60 if s4 is 0).

s4.label: Root speed
s4.description: Chance per step to grow one cell down. Side roots use s4 x 0.00005.

s6.label: Max side spread
s6.description: Maximum sideways distance of side roots.

s7.label: Max branches per level
s7.description: Roots stop growing into a cell once this many root cells are in the 3x3 ring on its level.

6.name: Roots
6.description: Finished roots. No parameters; never changes.
